about_the_game:
Pekla is a roguelike ARPG that focuses on defeating hordes of the damned and character progression.

Pekla is based on the poem Divine Comedy, specifically the first part, Inferno. You will journey through the nine circles of Hell, consisting of Limbo, Lust, Gluttony, Greed, Wrath, Heresy, Violence, Fraud, and finally Treachery.

In each circle, you must balance between slaying the damned, obtaining mystical items, and vanquishing bosses.

The only way is down...

9 Circles of Hell

Each circle represents a singular level with a thematic sin that you must conquer. In each circle, you will face hordes of the damned and have limited time to complete objectives. On top of that, every circle contains unique unlocks, secrets, monsters, and bosses.

Itemization

Experience a new-generation item system, where each item acts independently from the character and has its own stats. Each item can empower adjacent items, unlocking powerful synergies and builds. You can equip multiple weapons and multiple pieces of armor as long as they fit in your equipment bar.

Synergies

Each item is designed with unique effects, balancing around enabling different builds.

Here are a few examples:

  • Necronomicon can raise skeletons from dead bodies. Each skeleton gains same items that are adjacent to the book. As results skeletons uses this bow and sword.

  • A minion build using Raise Skeleton also benefits from Berserk, as it affects your minions, making them faster.

  • Instead of using minions purely for damage, combining them with a power that casts your highest-level spell on minion death can completely shift the dynamic, creating unique implications.

Skills have damage types that create synergies and anti-synergies:

  • Firebolt raises the temperature of monsters on impact, making them more vulnerable to further damage.

  • However, Cold damage reduces a monster’s temperature, negating the fire vulnerability but slowing them instead.

  • Poisoned monsters take periodic damage from gas, but raising their temperature detonates the gas in a volatile explosion, consuming the poison and dealing massive damage to nearby enemies.

Challenges

Each circle contains bosses that must be defeated in order to progress.

Bosses present unique challenges and serve as benchmarks for testing builds.

Each circle will also feature secret challenges tied to its particular sin.

Design Pillars

Pekla is designed around a few core pillars to ensure a clear vision for the game. This doesn’t mean that every system will perfectly align with these pillars, but it guarantees that as the game evolves, it will stay true to its core principles.

  • No hand-holding – We believe the best experiences come when players discover things on their own. This means the game won’t always provide clear indications about objectives, secrets, or where to go and what to avoid.

  • Easy to learn, hard to master – We want players to jump into the gameplay immediately without long introductions or tutorials while also offering a sense of mastery, where experience and skill can greatly impact future playthroughs. The game is also designed with a speedrunning component in mind.

  • Fun above balance – While balance is important to prevent the game from being dominated by a single meta, it should never come at the expense of fun.

  • Theory crafting – We want players to come up with creative builds rather than relying on simple stat padding. Instead of a single dominant build that completes the game, each build should come online at different stages, with unique power spikes and trade-offs.

  • Best idea wins – We carefully listen to player feedback and apply changes while staying true to the game's core pillars.

content_descriptors.notes: Game contains violence a, gore and lots of blood.

short_description: Descend into Hell in this horde survival action RPG. Battle through nine relentless circles, slay endless legions, and forge powerful builds in a dark world inspired by Dante’s Inferno. Brutal bosses and merciless hordes will break you again and again—only through torment will you endure.
